title: Blog
lead: Publish structured articles with editorial authors, topic archives, scheduled releases and moderated discussion.

sections.title: Create and edit articles
body: Open Blog → Articles and create an article with a unique slug, title, excerpt, author and structured blocks. Select public images through Images, write useful alternative text and choose categories or tags.

Keep work as a draft until it is ready. Published articles are public only after their UTC release time. Preview is authenticated; metadata, canonical links and social images remain under editorial control.

sections.title: Show articles inside a page
body: Use the shared component picker in Homepage or Pages. Select Blog → latest, a quantity of 1–12, an optional category and a supported template layout. Only released public articles are returned.

sections.title: Manage discussion and recovery
body: Comments start disabled. Enable them in Blog settings when needed; submissions remain pending until moderation and contain no email/IP fields.

Use Trash and History to recover content. RSS and sitemap include only permitted published data. Exports omit comments, moderation state, history and trash. Concurrent changes are rejected instead of silently overwritten.

sections.title: Raw articles and authored Mustache blocks
body: blog:posts(limit:1–12, category: optional category ID) returns items: id, title, excerpt, href, image, publishedAt, author (display name), categories and tags (arrays of display names). Only released published articles are included. blog:latest remains available for existing template-owned card formats.

Add an HTML / Mustache block to an article to reuse the core authoring control and public data bindings. Example with alias news: {{#news.items}}
{{title}}

{{excerpt}}

{{/news.items}}{{^news.items}}

No articles yet.

{{/news.items}}. Never add a service that recursively renders the same document. Blog is also a Homepage source for published article bodies; comments, moderation details, credentials and the site frame are excluded.
